question: What recitation is prescribed when incense or similar items are polluted by parts of living beings?
premises: Incense or similar items may be affected by parts of living beings
A recitation is prescribed as remedy
The recitation consists of one hundred repetitions of the fifth
inference: If incense or similar items are polluted by parts of living beings, one should recite the fifth one hundred times.
uncertainties: The identity of pañcama (fifth mantra/formula) is context-dependent
plain_english: If incense or the like is polluted by parts of living beings, one should recite the fifth a hundred times.
